questions.answerText: Words 2401 to 2500 from the Oxford 3000 list - the 3000 most important words to learn in English from A1 to B2 level. 2401. side - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /saɪd/ - English Meaning: One of the parts of an object, place, or area. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bên; phía. - Example: Stand on this side of the road. - Example Translation: Hãy đứng ở phía này của con đường. 2402. sight - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /saɪt/ - English Meaning: The ability to see; something that is seen. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thị giác; cảnh tượng. - Example: The mountains were a beautiful sight. - Example Translation: Những ngọn núi là một cảnh tượng tuyệt đẹp. 2403. sign - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /saɪn/ - English Meaning: A symbol or notice; to write your name. - Vietnamese Meaning: Dấu hiệu; ký tên. - Example: Please sign the document. - Example Translation: Vui lòng ký vào tài liệu. 2404. signal - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪɡnəl/ - English Meaning: A sign, message, or action that gives information. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tín hiệu. - Example: We lost the phone signal. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi mất tín hiệu điện thoại. 2405. significant - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt/ - English Meaning: Important or noticeable. - Vietnamese Meaning: Quan trọng; đáng kể. - Example: There was a significant increase in sales. - Example Translation: Đã có sự gia tăng đáng kể về doanh số. 2406. significantly - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/ - English Meaning: In an important or noticeable way. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đáng kể. - Example: Costs were reduced significantly. - Example Translation: Chi phí đã được giảm đáng kể. 2407. silence - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˈsaɪləns/ - English Meaning: Complete absence of sound. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự im lặng. - Example: The room fell into silence. - Example Translation: Căn phòng chìm trong im lặng. 2408. silent - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈsaɪlənt/ - English Meaning: Not making any sound. - Vietnamese Meaning: Im lặng. - Example: He remained silent during the meeting. - Example Translation: Anh ấy giữ im lặng trong cuộc họp. 2409. silk - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /sɪlk/ - English Meaning: A soft, smooth fabric made from silkworms. - Vietnamese Meaning: Lụa. - Example: She wore a silk dress. - Example Translation: Cô ấy mặc một chiếc váy lụa. 2410. silly - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪli/ - English Meaning: Showing a lack of good judgment; foolish. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ngớ ngẩn. - Example: That was a silly mistake. - Example Translation: Đó là một lỗi ngớ ngẩn. 2411. silver - Type: Noun, Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪlvər/ - English Meaning: A valuable gray-white metal; having the color of silver. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bạc; màu bạc. - Example: She won a silver medal. - Example Translation: Cô ấy đã giành được huy chương bạc. 2412. similar - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪmələr/ - English Meaning: Almost the same. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tương tự; giống nhau. - Example: The two houses look very similar. - Example Translation: Hai ngôi nhà trông rất giống nhau. 2413. similarity - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˌsɪməˈlærəti/ - English Meaning: The state of being similar. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự tương đồng. - Example: There is a strong similarity between the two designs. - Example Translation: Có sự tương đồng lớn giữa hai thiết kế. 2414. similarly - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪmələrli/ - English Meaning: In a similar way. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tương tự. - Example: Similarly, the second study reached the same conclusion. - Example Translation: Tương tự, nghiên cứu thứ hai cũng đi đến kết luận như vậy. 2415. simple - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪmpl/ - English Meaning: Easy to understand or do. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đơn giản. - Example: The instructions are simple to follow. - Example Translation: Các hướng dẫn rất dễ làm theo. 2416. simply - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪmpli/ - English Meaning: In a simple way; only. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đơn giản; chỉ. - Example: Simply press the button to start. - Example Translation: Chỉ cần nhấn nút để bắt đầu. 2417. since - Type: Preposition, Conjunction, Adverb - CEFR Level: A2, B1 - IPA (US): /sɪns/ - English Meaning: From a point in the past until now; because. - Vietnamese Meaning: Kể từ; vì. - Example: I have lived here since 2020. - Example Translation: Tôi đã sống ở đây từ năm 2020. 2418. sincere - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /sɪnˈsɪr/ - English Meaning: Honest and genuine. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chân thành. - Example: Please accept my sincere thanks. - Example Translation: Xin hãy nhận lời cảm ơn chân thành của tôi. 2419. sing - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /sɪŋ/ - English Meaning: To make musical sounds with your voice. - Vietnamese Meaning: Hát. - Example: She loves to sing. - Example Translation: Cô ấy thích hát. 2420. singer - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪŋər/ - English Meaning: A person who sings. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ca sĩ. - Example: The singer performed beautifully. - Example Translation: Ca sĩ đã biểu diễn rất hay. 2421. singing - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪŋɪŋ/ - English Meaning: The activity of producing musical sounds with the voice. - Vietnamese Meaning: Việc hát. - Example: Singing helps her relax. - Example Translation: Ca hát giúp cô ấy thư giãn. 2422. single - Type: Adjective, Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪŋɡl/ - English Meaning: One only; not married. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đơn lẻ; độc thân. - Example: Every student received a single sheet of paper. - Example Translation: Mỗi học sinh nhận một tờ giấy. 2423. sink - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /sɪŋk/ - English Meaning: To go down below the surface of water. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chìm. - Example: The boat began to sink. - Example Translation: Con thuyền bắt đầu chìm. 2424. sir - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /sɜːr/ - English Meaning: A polite form of address to a man. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thưa ông. - Example: Can I help you, sir? - Example Translation: Tôi có thể giúp gì cho ông không? 2425. sister - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪstər/ - English Meaning: A female sibling. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chị gái; em gái. - Example: My sister works in a hospital. - Example Translation: Chị gái tôi làm việc trong bệnh viện. 2426. sit - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /sɪt/ - English Meaning: To rest on a chair or other surface. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ngồi. - Example: Please sit down and relax. - Example Translation: Hãy ngồi xuống và thư giãn. 2427. site - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /saɪt/ - English Meaning: A place where something exists or happens. - Vietnamese Meaning: Địa điểm; vị trí. - Example: The construction site is closed today. - Example Translation: Công trường xây dựng hôm nay đóng cửa. 2428. situation - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən/ - English Meaning: The set of conditions that exist at a particular time. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tình huống. - Example: It's a difficult situation. - Example Translation: Đó là một tình huống khó khăn. 2429. six - Type: Number - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /sɪks/ - English Meaning: The number 6. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sáu. - Example: There are six people in the room. - Example Translation: Có sáu người trong phòng. 2430. sixteen - Type: Number - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˌsɪksˈtiːn/ - English Meaning: The number 16. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mười sáu. - Example: She is sixteen years old. - Example Translation: Cô ấy mười sáu tuổi. 2431. sixty - Type: Number - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɪksti/ - English Meaning: The number 60. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sáu mươi. - Example: Sixty students attended the event. - Example Translation: Sáu mươi học sinh đã tham dự sự kiện. 2432. size - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /saɪz/ - English Meaning: How large or small something is. - Vietnamese Meaning: Kích thước. - Example: What size shoes do you wear? - Example Translation: Bạn mang cỡ giày nào? 2433. ski - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /skiː/ - English Meaning: To move over snow using skis. - Vietnamese Meaning: Trượt tuyết; ván trượt tuyết. - Example: They ski every winter. - Example Translation: Họ trượt tuyết mỗi mùa đông. 2434. skiing - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈskiːɪŋ/ - English Meaning: The sport or activity of traveling on skis. - Vietnamese Meaning: Môn trượt tuyết. - Example: Skiing is popular in Switzerland. - Example Translation: Trượt tuyết rất phổ biến ở Thụy Sĩ. 2435. skill - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /skɪl/ - English Meaning: The ability to do something well. - Vietnamese Meaning: Kỹ năng. - Example: Communication is an important skill. - Example Translation: Giao tiếp là một kỹ năng quan trọng. 2436. skin - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /skɪn/ - English Meaning: The outer layer of the body. - Vietnamese Meaning: Da. - Example: Protect your skin from the sun. - Example Translation: Hãy bảo vệ làn da khỏi ánh nắng mặt trời. 2437. skirt - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /skɜːrt/ - English Meaning: A garment worn by women and girls. - Vietnamese Meaning: Váy. - Example: She bought a new skirt. - Example Translation: Cô ấy đã mua một chiếc váy mới. 2438. sky - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /skaɪ/ - English Meaning: The area above the earth where clouds and stars appear. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bầu trời. - Example: The sky is clear today. - Example Translation: Hôm nay bầu trời quang đãng. 2439. slave - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /sleɪv/ - English Meaning: A person who is forced to work and is owned by another person. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nô lệ. - Example: The book tells the story of a former slave. - Example Translation: Cuốn sách kể câu chuyện về một người từng là nô lệ. 2440. sleep - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: A1, A2 - IPA (US): /sliːp/ - English Meaning: To rest with your eyes closed; a period of rest. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ngủ; giấc ngủ. - Example: I need more sleep. - Example Translation: Tôi cần ngủ nhiều hơn. 2441. slice - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /slaɪs/ - English Meaning: A thin piece cut from something; to cut into thin pieces. - Vietnamese Meaning: Lát; cắt lát. - Example: I'd like a slice of pizza. - Example Translation: Tôi muốn một lát bánh pizza. 2442. slide - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /slaɪd/ - English Meaning: To move smoothly across a surface; a smooth movement. - Vietnamese Meaning: Trượt; sự trượt. - Example: The children slid down the hill. - Example Translation: Những đứa trẻ trượt xuống đồi. 2443. slight - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /slaɪt/ - English Meaning: Small and not very important. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nhẹ; nhỏ. - Example: There was a slight delay in the meeting. - Example Translation: Có một sự chậm trễ nhỏ trong cuộc họp. 2444. slightly - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈslaɪtli/ - English Meaning: A little. - Vietnamese Meaning: Hơi; một chút. - Example: The room was slightly cold. - Example Translation: Căn phòng hơi lạnh. 2445. slip - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /slɪp/ - English Meaning: To slide accidentally and lose balance. - Vietnamese Meaning: Trượt ngã. - Example: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor. - Example Translation: Hãy cẩn thận đừng trượt ngã trên sàn ướt. 2446. slope - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /sloʊp/ - English Meaning: A surface that rises or falls at an angle. - Vietnamese Meaning: Dốc; nghiêng. - Example: They climbed a steep slope. - Example Translation: Họ leo lên một con dốc cao. 2447. slow - Type: Adjective, Verb - CEFR Level: A1, B1 - IPA (US): /sloʊ/ - English Meaning: Not fast; to reduce speed. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chậm; làm chậm lại. - Example: Traffic was very slow this morning. - Example Translation: Giao thông sáng nay rất chậm. 2448. slowly - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsloʊli/ - English Meaning: At a slow speed. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chậm chạp. - Example: Please speak slowly. - Example Translation: Xin hãy nói chậm lại. 2449. small - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /smɔːl/ - English Meaning: Little in size. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nhỏ. - Example: They live in a small house. - Example Translation: Họ sống trong một ngôi nhà nhỏ. 2450. smart - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /smɑːrt/ - English Meaning: Intelligent; neat and fashionable. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thông minh; lịch sự. - Example: She is a very smart student. - Example Translation: Cô ấy là một học sinh rất thông minh. 2451. smartphone - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsmɑːrtfoʊn/ - English Meaning: A mobile phone with advanced features. - Vietnamese Meaning: Điện thoại thông minh. - Example: I bought a new smartphone. - Example Translation: Tôi đã mua một chiếc điện thoại thông minh mới. 2452. smell - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /smel/ - English Meaning: The quality noticed by the nose; to notice an odor. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mùi; ngửi. - Example: I can smell fresh coffee. - Example Translation: Tôi có thể ngửi thấy mùi cà phê mới pha. 2453. smile - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /smaɪl/ - English Meaning: A happy expression on the face. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nụ cười; mỉm cười. - Example: She greeted me with a smile. - Example Translation: Cô ấy chào tôi bằng một nụ cười. 2454. smoke - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /smoʊk/ - English Meaning: The gray gas produced by fire; to inhale tobacco smoke. - Vietnamese Meaning: Khói; hút thuốc. - Example: Smoke filled the room. - Example Translation: Khói phủ kín căn phòng. 2455. smoking - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsmoʊkɪŋ/ - English Meaning: The activity of smoking tobacco. - Vietnamese Meaning: Việc hút thuốc. - Example: Smoking is harmful to health. - Example Translation: Hút thuốc có hại cho sức khỏe. 2456. smooth - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /smuːð/ - English Meaning: Having an even surface; without difficulties. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mịn màng; suôn sẻ. - Example: The road was smooth and wide. - Example Translation: Con đường bằng phẳng và rộng. 2457. snake - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /sneɪk/ - English Meaning: A long reptile without legs. - Vietnamese Meaning: Con rắn. - Example: We saw a snake in the garden. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi nhìn thấy một con rắn trong vườn. 2458. sneaker - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsniːkər/ - English Meaning: A soft shoe worn for sports or casual use. - Vietnamese Meaning: Giày thể thao. - Example: He wore white sneakers. - Example Translation: Anh ấy mang giày thể thao màu trắng. 2459. snow - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /snoʊ/ - English Meaning: Frozen water that falls from the sky. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tuyết; có tuyết rơi. - Example: It began to snow last night. - Example Translation: Tối qua trời bắt đầu có tuyết. 2460. so - Type: Adverb, Conjunction - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /soʊ/ - English Meaning: To a great degree; therefore. - Vietnamese Meaning: Rất; vì vậy. - Example: I was tired, so I went to bed early. - Example Translation: Tôi mệt nên đi ngủ sớm. 2461. soap - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /soʊp/ - English Meaning: A substance used for washing. - Vietnamese Meaning: Xà phòng. - Example: Wash your hands with soap. - Example Translation: Hãy rửa tay bằng xà phòng. 2462. soccer - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsɑːkər/ - English Meaning: A sport played by two teams kicking a ball. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bóng đá. - Example: Soccer is popular around the world. - Example Translation: Bóng đá phổ biến trên khắp thế giới. 2463. social - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsoʊʃl/ - English Meaning: Related to society or interactions with others. - Vietnamese Meaning: Xã hội. - Example: Social media influences many people. - Example Translation: Mạng xã hội ảnh hưởng đến nhiều người. 2464. society - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /səˈsaɪəti/ - English Meaning: People living together in communities. - Vietnamese Meaning: Xã hội. - Example: Education plays an important role in society. - Example Translation: Giáo dục đóng vai trò quan trọng trong xã hội. 2465. sock - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /sɑːk/ - English Meaning: A piece of clothing worn on the foot. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tất; vớ. - Example: I need a new pair of socks. - Example Translation: Tôi cần một đôi tất mới. 2466. soft - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /sɔːft/ - English Meaning: Easy to press or bend; not hard. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mềm. - Example: The pillow is very soft. - Example Translation: Chiếc gối rất mềm. 2467. software - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɔːftwer/ - English Meaning: Computer programs and operating information. - Vietnamese Meaning: Phần mềm. - Example: The software needs an update. - Example Translation: Phần mềm cần được cập nhật. 2468. soil - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /sɔɪl/ - English Meaning: The top layer of earth where plants grow. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đất. - Example: Rich soil helps plants grow well. - Example Translation: Đất màu mỡ giúp cây phát triển tốt. 2469. solar - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˈsoʊlər/ - English Meaning: Related to the sun. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thuộc mặt trời. - Example: They installed solar panels on the roof. - Example Translation: Họ lắp đặt các tấm pin mặt trời trên mái nhà. 2470. soldier - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsoʊldʒər/ - English Meaning: A member of an army. - Vietnamese Meaning: Người lính. - Example: The soldier returned home safely. - Example Translation: Người lính đã trở về nhà an toàn. 2471. solid - Type: Adjective, Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɑːlɪd/ - English Meaning: Firm and hard; một ít. - Example: I need some help. - Example Translation: Tôi cần một chút giúp đỡ. 2475. somebody - Type: Pronoun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈsʌmbədi/ - English Meaning: Some person. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ai đó. - Example: Somebody is waiting for you. - Example Translation: Có ai đó đang đợi bạn. 2476. someone - Type: Pronoun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈsʌmwʌn/ - English Meaning: Some person. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ai đó. - Example: Someone left a message for you. - Example Translation: Ai đó đã để lại lời nhắn cho bạn. 2477. something - Type: Pronoun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈsʌmθɪŋ/ - English Meaning: A thing that is not specified. - Vietnamese Meaning: Một cái gì đó. - Example: I have something to tell you. - Example Translation: Tôi có điều gì đó muốn nói với bạn. 2478. sometimes - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈsʌmtaɪmz/ - English Meaning: On some occasions but not always. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đôi khi. - Example: I sometimes go for a walk after dinner. - Example Translation: Tôi đôi khi đi dạo sau bữa tối. 2479. somewhat - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˈsʌmwʌt/ - English Meaning: To a moderate degree. - Vietnamese Meaning: Hơi; phần nào. - Example: The task was somewhat difficult. - Example Translation: Nhiệm vụ hơi khó. 2480. somewhere - Type: Adverb, Pronoun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈsʌmwer/ - English Meaning: In, at, or to an unspecified place. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ở đâu đó. - Example: Let's go somewhere quiet. - Example Translation: Hãy đến một nơi nào đó yên tĩnh. 2481. son - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /sʌn/ - English Meaning: A male child. - Vietnamese Meaning: Con trai. - Example: Their son is ten years old. - Example Translation: Con trai của họ mười tuổi. 2482. song - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /sɔːŋ/ - English Meaning: A short piece of music with words. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bài hát. - Example: This is my favorite song. - Example Translation: Đây là bài hát yêu thích của tôi. 2483. soon - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /suːn/ - English Meaning: In a short time. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sớm; chẳng bao lâu. - Example: See you soon. - Example Translation: Hẹn gặp bạn sớm. 2484. sorry - Type: Adjective, Exclamation - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈsɑːri/ - English Meaning: Feeling regret or sympathy. - Vietnamese Meaning: Xin lỗi; tiếc. - Example: I'm sorry for being late. - Example Translation: Tôi xin lỗi vì đã đến muộn. 2485. sort - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2, B1 - IPA (US): /sɔːrt/ - English Meaning: A type of something; to arrange into groups. - Vietnamese Meaning: Loại; sắp xếp. - Example: What sort of books do you like? - Example Translation: Bạn thích loại sách nào? 2486. soul - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /soʊl/ - English Meaning: The spiritual part of a person. - Vietnamese Meaning: Linh hồn. - Example: Music speaks to the soul. - Example Translation: Âm nhạc chạm đến tâm hồn. 2487. sound - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /saʊnd/ - English Meaning: Something that can be heard. - Vietnamese Meaning: Âm thanh. - Example: I heard a strange sound. - Example Translation: Tôi nghe thấy một âm thanh lạ. 2488. soup - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /suːp/ - English Meaning: A liquid food, usually served hot. - Vietnamese Meaning: Súp. - Example: The soup is delicious. - Example Translation: Món súp rất ngon. 2489. source - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /sɔːrs/ - English Meaning: The origin of something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nguồn. - Example: The internet is a useful source of information. - Example Translation: Internet là một nguồn thông tin hữu ích. 2490. south - Type: Noun, Adjective, Adverb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /saʊθ/ - English Meaning: The direction opposite north. - Vietnamese Meaning: Phía nam. - Example: They traveled south for the winter. - Example Translation: Họ đi về phía nam vào mùa đông. 2491. southern - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈsʌðərn/ - English Meaning: Located in or relating to the south. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thuộc phía nam. - Example: She grew up in southern France. - Example Translation: Cô ấy lớn lên ở miền nam nước Pháp. 2492. space - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /speɪs/ - English Meaning: An empty area; the universe beyond Earth. - Vietnamese Meaning: Không gian. - Example: We need more space in the office. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi cần nhiều không gian hơn trong văn phòng. 2493. speak - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /spiːk/ - English Meaning: To say words; to communicate orally. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nói. - Example: She speaks three languages. - Example Translation: Cô ấy nói được ba ngôn ngữ. 2494. speaker - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈspiːkər/ - English Meaning: A person who speaks or a device that produces sound. - Vietnamese Meaning: Người phát biểu; loa. - Example: The speaker gave an inspiring talk. - Example Translation: Diễn giả đã có một bài nói chuyện truyền cảm hứng. 2495. special - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈspeʃl/ - English Meaning: Different from what is usual; questions.answerHtml:
Words 2401 to 2500 from the Oxford 3000 list - the 3000 most important words to learn in English from A1 to B2 level.

2401. side

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /saɪd/
  • English Meaning: One of the parts of an object, place, or area.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bên; phía.
  • Example: Stand on this side of the road.
  • Example Translation: Hãy đứng ở phía này của con đường.

2402. sight

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /saɪt/
  • English Meaning: The ability to see; something that is seen.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thị giác; cảnh tượng.
  • Example: The mountains were a beautiful sight.
  • Example Translation: Những ngọn núi là một cảnh tượng tuyệt đẹp.

2403. sign

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /saɪn/
  • English Meaning: A symbol or notice; to write your name.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Dấu hiệu; ký tên.
  • Example: Please sign the document.
  • Example Translation: Vui lòng ký vào tài liệu.

2404. signal

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪɡnəl/
  • English Meaning: A sign, message, or action that gives information.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tín hiệu.
  • Example: We lost the phone signal.
  • Example Translation: Chúng tôi mất tín hiệu điện thoại.

2405. significant

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt/
  • English Meaning: Important or noticeable.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Quan trọng; đáng kể.
  • Example: There was a significant increase in sales.
  • Example Translation: Đã có sự gia tăng đáng kể về doanh số.

2406. significantly

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
  • English Meaning: In an important or noticeable way.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đáng kể.
  • Example: Costs were reduced significantly.
  • Example Translation: Chi phí đã được giảm đáng kể.

2407. silence

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈsaɪləns/
  • English Meaning: Complete absence of sound.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sự im lặng.
  • Example: The room fell into silence.
  • Example Translation: Căn phòng chìm trong im lặng.

2408. silent

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsaɪlənt/
  • English Meaning: Not making any sound.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Im lặng.
  • Example: He remained silent during the meeting.
  • Example Translation: Anh ấy giữ im lặng trong cuộc họp.

2409. silk

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /sɪlk/
  • English Meaning: A soft, smooth fabric made from silkworms.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Lụa.
  • Example: She wore a silk dress.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy mặc một chiếc váy lụa.

2410. silly

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪli/
  • English Meaning: Showing a lack of good judgment; foolish.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ngớ ngẩn.
  • Example: That was a silly mistake.
  • Example Translation: Đó là một lỗi ngớ ngẩn.

2411. silver

  • Type: Noun, Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪlvər/
  • English Meaning: A valuable gray-white metal; having the color of silver.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bạc; màu bạc.
  • Example: She won a silver medal.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy đã giành được huy chương bạc.

2412. similar

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪmələr/
  • English Meaning: Almost the same.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tương tự; giống nhau.
  • Example: The two houses look very similar.
  • Example Translation: Hai ngôi nhà trông rất giống nhau.

2413. similarity

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˌsɪməˈlærəti/
  • English Meaning: The state of being similar.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sự tương đồng.
  • Example: There is a strong similarity between the two designs.
  • Example Translation: Có sự tương đồng lớn giữa hai thiết kế.

2414. similarly

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪmələrli/
  • English Meaning: In a similar way.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tương tự.
  • Example: Similarly, the second study reached the same conclusion.
  • Example Translation: Tương tự, nghiên cứu thứ hai cũng đi đến kết luận như vậy.

2415. simple

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪmpl/
  • English Meaning: Easy to understand or do.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đơn giản.
  • Example: The instructions are simple to follow.
  • Example Translation: Các hướng dẫn rất dễ làm theo.

2416. simply

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪmpli/
  • English Meaning: In a simple way; only.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đơn giản; chỉ.
  • Example: Simply press the button to start.
  • Example Translation: Chỉ cần nhấn nút để bắt đầu.

2417. since

  • Type: Preposition, Conjunction, Adverb
  • CEFR Level: A2, B1
  • IPA (US): /sɪns/
  • English Meaning: From a point in the past until now; because.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Kể từ; vì.
  • Example: I have lived here since 2020.
  • Example Translation: Tôi đã sống ở đây từ năm 2020.

2418. sincere

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /sɪnˈsɪr/
  • English Meaning: Honest and genuine.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chân thành.
  • Example: Please accept my sincere thanks.
  • Example Translation: Xin hãy nhận lời cảm ơn chân thành của tôi.

2419. sing

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /sɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: To make musical sounds with your voice.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hát.
  • Example: She loves to sing.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy thích hát.

2420. singer

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪŋər/
  • English Meaning: A person who sings.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ca sĩ.
  • Example: The singer performed beautifully.
  • Example Translation: Ca sĩ đã biểu diễn rất hay.

2421. singing

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪŋɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: The activity of producing musical sounds with the voice.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Việc hát.
  • Example: Singing helps her relax.
  • Example Translation: Ca hát giúp cô ấy thư giãn.

2422. single

  • Type: Adjective, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪŋɡl/
  • English Meaning: One only; not married.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đơn lẻ; độc thân.
  • Example: Every student received a single sheet of paper.
  • Example Translation: Mỗi học sinh nhận một tờ giấy.

2423. sink

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /sɪŋk/
  • English Meaning: To go down below the surface of water.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chìm.
  • Example: The boat began to sink.
  • Example Translation: Con thuyền bắt đầu chìm.

2424. sir

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /sɜːr/
  • English Meaning: A polite form of address to a man.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thưa ông.
  • Example: Can I help you, sir?
  • Example Translation: Tôi có thể giúp gì cho ông không?

2425. sister

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪstər/
  • English Meaning: A female sibling.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chị gái; em gái.
  • Example: My sister works in a hospital.
  • Example Translation: Chị gái tôi làm việc trong bệnh viện.

2426. sit

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /sɪt/
  • English Meaning: To rest on a chair or other surface.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ngồi.
  • Example: Please sit down and relax.
  • Example Translation: Hãy ngồi xuống và thư giãn.

2427. site

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /saɪt/
  • English Meaning: A place where something exists or happens.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Địa điểm; vị trí.
  • Example: The construction site is closed today.
  • Example Translation: Công trường xây dựng hôm nay đóng cửa.

2428. situation

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən/
  • English Meaning: The set of conditions that exist at a particular time.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tình huống.
  • Example: It's a difficult situation.
  • Example Translation: Đó là một tình huống khó khăn.

2429. six

  • Type: Number
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /sɪks/
  • English Meaning: The number 6.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sáu.
  • Example: There are six people in the room.
  • Example Translation: Có sáu người trong phòng.

2430. sixteen

  • Type: Number
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˌsɪksˈtiːn/
  • English Meaning: The number 16.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mười sáu.
  • Example: She is sixteen years old.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy mười sáu tuổi.

2431. sixty

  • Type: Number
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɪksti/
  • English Meaning: The number 60.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sáu mươi.
  • Example: Sixty students attended the event.
  • Example Translation: Sáu mươi học sinh đã tham dự sự kiện.

2432. size

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /saɪz/
  • English Meaning: How large or small something is.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Kích thước.
  • Example: What size shoes do you wear?
  • Example Translation: Bạn mang cỡ giày nào?

2433. ski

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /skiː/
  • English Meaning: To move over snow using skis.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Trượt tuyết; ván trượt tuyết.
  • Example: They ski every winter.
  • Example Translation: Họ trượt tuyết mỗi mùa đông.

2434. skiing

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈskiːɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: The sport or activity of traveling on skis.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Môn trượt tuyết.
  • Example: Skiing is popular in Switzerland.
  • Example Translation: Trượt tuyết rất phổ biến ở Thụy Sĩ.

2435. skill

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /skɪl/
  • English Meaning: The ability to do something well.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Kỹ năng.
  • Example: Communication is an important skill.
  • Example Translation: Giao tiếp là một kỹ năng quan trọng.

2436. skin

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /skɪn/
  • English Meaning: The outer layer of the body.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Da.
  • Example: Protect your skin from the sun.
  • Example Translation: Hãy bảo vệ làn da khỏi ánh nắng mặt trời.

2437. skirt

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /skɜːrt/
  • English Meaning: A garment worn by women and girls.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Váy.
  • Example: She bought a new skirt.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy đã mua một chiếc váy mới.

2438. sky

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /skaɪ/
  • English Meaning: The area above the earth where clouds and stars appear.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bầu trời.
  • Example: The sky is clear today.
  • Example Translation: Hôm nay bầu trời quang đãng.

2439. slave

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /sleɪv/

questions.answerHtml:
Words 2501 to 2600 from the Oxford 3000 list - the 3000 most important words to learn in English from A1 to B2 level.

2501. speed

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2, B2
  • IPA (US): /spiːd/
  • English Meaning: The rate at which someone or something moves; to move quickly.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tốc độ; tăng tốc.
  • Example: The car was traveling at high speed.
  • Example Translation: Chiếc xe đang di chuyển với tốc độ cao.

2502. spell

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /spel/
  • English Meaning: To write or say the letters of a word in the correct order.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đánh vần.
  • Example: Can you spell your name?
  • Example Translation: Bạn có thể đánh vần tên của mình không?

2503. spelling

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈspelɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: The way a word is written.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cách đánh vần; chính tả.
  • Example: Your spelling is excellent.
  • Example Translation: Chính tả của bạn rất tốt.

2504. spend

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /spend/
  • English Meaning: To use money, time, or energy.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chi tiêu; dành thời gian.
  • Example: I spent two hours reading.
  • Example Translation: Tôi đã dành hai giờ để đọc sách.

2505. spending

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈspendɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: The act of using money.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chi tiêu.
  • Example: Government spending increased this year.
  • Example Translation: Chi tiêu của chính phủ đã tăng trong năm nay.

2506. spicy

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈspaɪsi/
  • English Meaning: Having a strong hot flavor from spices.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cay.
  • Example: Thai food is often very spicy.
  • Example Translation: Đồ ăn Thái thường rất cay.

2507. spider

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈspaɪdər/
  • English Meaning: A small creature with eight legs.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Con nhện.
  • Example: A spider was hanging from the ceiling.
  • Example Translation: Một con nhện đang treo trên trần nhà.

2508. spirit

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈspɪrɪt/
  • English Meaning: A person's mood, attitude, or inner nature.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tinh thần.
  • Example: The team showed great spirit.
  • Example Translation: Đội đã thể hiện tinh thần tuyệt vời.

2509. spiritual

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈspɪrɪtʃuəl/
  • English Meaning: Related to the human spirit rather than physical things.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thuộc tinh thần; tâm linh.
  • Example: She is interested in spiritual practices.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy quan tâm đến các hoạt động tâm linh.

2510. split

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /splɪt/
  • English Meaning: To divide into parts; a division.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chia tách; sự phân chia.
  • Example: They decided to split the costs equally.
  • Example Translation: Họ quyết định chia đều các chi phí.

2511. spoken

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈspoʊkən/
  • English Meaning: Expressed in speech rather than writing.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Được nói; bằng lời nói.
  • Example: Spoken English is important for communication.
  • Example Translation: Tiếng Anh nói rất quan trọng trong giao tiếp.

2512. sponsor

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈspɑːnsər/
  • English Meaning: A person or organization that supports an event or activity financially.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhà tài trợ; tài trợ.
  • Example: The company agreed to sponsor the event.
  • Example Translation: Công ty đã đồng ý tài trợ cho sự kiện.

2513. spoon

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /spuːn/
  • English Meaning: A tool used for eating or serving food.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cái thìa.
  • Example: She stirred her tea with a spoon.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy khuấy trà bằng thìa.

2514. sport

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /spɔːrt/
  • English Meaning: A physical activity played for enjoyment or competition.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thể thao.
  • Example: Soccer is the most popular sport in many countries.
  • Example Translation: Bóng đá là môn thể thao phổ biến nhất ở nhiều quốc gia.

2515. spot

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1, B2
  • IPA (US): /spɑːt/
  • English Meaning: A particular place; to notice something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Vị trí; phát hiện.
  • Example: I spotted a bird in the tree.
  • Example Translation: Tôi phát hiện một con chim trên cây.

2516. spread

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1, B2
  • IPA (US): /spred/
  • English Meaning: To move over a larger area; the act of spreading.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Lan rộng; sự lan truyền.
  • Example: The news spread quickly.
  • Example Translation: Tin tức lan truyền rất nhanh.

2517. spring

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1, B1
  • IPA (US): /sprɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: The season between winter and summer; to jump suddenly.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mùa xuân; nhảy bật lên.
  • Example: Flowers bloom in spring.
  • Example Translation: Hoa nở vào mùa xuân.

2518. square

  • Type: Adjective, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /skwer/
  • English Meaning: Having four equal sides and angles.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hình vuông; quảng trường.
  • Example: Draw a square on the paper.
  • Example Translation: Hãy vẽ một hình vuông trên giấy.

2519. stable

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈsteɪbl/
  • English Meaning: Not likely to change or fail.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ổn định.
  • Example: The economy remains stable.
  • Example Translation: Nền kinh tế vẫn ổn định.

2520. stadium

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsteɪdiəm/
  • English Meaning: A large sports arena.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sân vận động.
  • Example: Thousands of fans filled the stadium.
  • Example Translation: Hàng nghìn người hâm mộ đã lấp đầy sân vận động.

2521. staff

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /stæf/
  • English Meaning: The people who work for an organization.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhân viên.
  • Example: The staff were very helpful.
  • Example Translation: Nhân viên rất nhiệt tình giúp đỡ.

2522. stage

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2, B2
  • IPA (US): /steɪdʒ/
  • English Meaning: A phase in a process; a platform for performances.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Giai đoạn; sân khấu.
  • Example: The project entered its final stage.
  • Example Translation: Dự án bước vào giai đoạn cuối.

2523. stair

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ster/
  • English Meaning: One of a series of steps in a building.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bậc thang.
  • Example: Be careful on the stairs.
  • Example Translation: Hãy cẩn thận khi đi cầu thang.

2524. stamp

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /stæmp/
  • English Meaning: A small piece of paper used for mailing letters.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tem thư.
  • Example: I bought a stamp for the postcard.
  • Example Translation: Tôi đã mua một con tem cho bưu thiếp.

2525. stand

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1, B2
  • IPA (US): /stænd/
  • English Meaning: To be in an upright position.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đứng.
  • Example: Please stand near the door.
  • Example Translation: Hãy đứng gần cửa.

2526. standard

  • Type: Noun, Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈstændərd/
  • English Meaning: A level of quality or achievement.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tiêu chuẩn.
  • Example: The product meets international standards.
  • Example Translation: Sản phẩm đáp ứng các tiêu chuẩn quốc tế.

2527. star

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1, A2
  • IPA (US): /stɑːr/
  • English Meaning: A bright object in the sky; to be the main performer.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ngôi sao; đóng vai chính.
  • Example: We saw many stars in the sky.
  • Example Translation: Chúng tôi nhìn thấy nhiều ngôi sao trên bầu trời.

2528. stare

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ster/
  • English Meaning: To look at someone or something for a long time.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhìn chằm chằm.
  • Example: It's rude to stare at people.
  • Example Translation: Nhìn chằm chằm vào người khác là bất lịch sự.

2529. start

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1, A2
  • IPA (US): /stɑːrt/
  • English Meaning: To begin; the beginning of something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bắt đầu.
  • Example: Let's start the meeting.
  • Example Translation: Hãy bắt đầu cuộc họp.

2530. state

  • Type: Noun, Adjective, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2, B1
  • IPA (US): /steɪt/
  • English Meaning: A condition, a region of a country, or to express formally.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tình trạng; bang; tuyên bố.
  • Example: The report stated the facts clearly.
  • Example Translation: Báo cáo đã nêu rõ các sự kiện.

2531. statement

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsteɪtmənt/
  • English Meaning: Something that is said or written to give information.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tuyên bố; phát biểu.
  • Example: The company released an official statement.
  • Example Translation: Công ty đã đưa ra một tuyên bố chính thức.

2532. station

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsteɪʃn/
  • English Meaning: A place where trains, buses, or other transport stop.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nhà ga; trạm.
  • Example: We arrived at the station early.
  • Example Translation: Chúng tôi đến nhà ga sớm.

2533. statistic

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /stəˈtɪstɪk/
  • English Meaning: A piece of numerical information.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Số liệu thống kê.
  • Example: The statistic shows a rise in sales.
  • Example Translation: Số liệu thống kê cho thấy doanh số tăng.

2534. statue

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈstætʃuː/
  • English Meaning: A figure of a person or animal made of stone, metal, etc.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Tượng.
  • Example: The statue stands in the center of the park.
  • Example Translation: Bức tượng đứng ở trung tâm công viên.

2535. status

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈsteɪtəs/
  • English Meaning: The position or condition of someone or something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Trạng thái; địa vị.
  • Example: Check the status of your application online.
  • Example Translation: Kiểm tra trạng thái đơn đăng ký của bạn trực tuyến.

2536. stay

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1, A2
  • IPA (US): /steɪ/
  • English Meaning: To remain in a place; a period of living somewhere.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ở lại; kỳ lưu trú.
  • Example: We stayed at a small hotel.

2537. steady

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈstedi/
  • English Meaning: Regular and not changing suddenly.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ổn định.
  • Example: The company achieved steady growth.
  • Example Translation: Công ty đạt được sự tăng trưởng ổn định.

2538. steal

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /stiːl/
  • English Meaning: To take something illegally.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ăn cắp.
  • Example: Someone stole my bicycle.
  • Example Translation: Ai đó đã lấy cắp xe đạp của tôi.

2539. steel

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /stiːl/
  • English Meaning: A strong metal used for building and manufacturing.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thép.
  • Example: The bridge is made of steel.

2540. steep

  • IPA (US): /stiːp/
  • English Meaning: Rising or falling sharply.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Dốc.

2541. step

  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bước chân; bước đi.

2542. stick

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /stɪk/
  • English Meaning: To attach or fasten something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Dán; gắn.
  • Example: Stick the label on the box.
  • Example Translation: Hãy dán nhãn lên chiếc hộp.

2543. stick

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /stɪk/
  • English Meaning: A thin piece of wood.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Que; cành cây.
  • Example: The child picked up a stick.
  • Example Translation: Đứa trẻ nhặt một cành cây.

2544. sticky

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈstɪki/
  • English Meaning: Covered with a substance that sticks.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Dính; nhớp.
  • Example: My hands are sticky from the candy.
  • Example Translation: Tay tôi bị dính do ăn kẹo.

2545. still

  • Type: Adverb, Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1, B1
  • IPA (US): /stɪl/
  • English Meaning: Continuing up to now; not moving.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Vẫn; đứng yên.
  • Example: She is still waiting for a reply.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy vẫn đang chờ phản hồi.

2546. stock

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /stɑːk/
  • English Meaning: Goods available for sale or shares in a company.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hàng tồn kho; cổ phiếu.
  • Example: The store has plenty of stock.
  • Example Translation: Cửa hàng có rất nhiều hàng hóa.

2547. stomach

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈstʌmək/
  • English Meaning: The organ where food is digested.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Dạ dày; bụng.
  • Example: My stomach hurts.
  • Example Translation: Tôi bị đau bụng.

2548. stone

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /stoʊn/
  • English Meaning: A hard piece of rock.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đá.
  • Example: The wall was built from stone.
  • Example Translation: Bức tường được xây bằng đá.

2549. stop

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /stɑːp/
  • English Meaning: To end an action; a place where vehicles stop.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Dừng lại; điểm dừng.
  • Example: Please stop talking.

2550. store

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1, B1
  • IPA (US): /stɔːr/
  • English Meaning: A shop; to keep something for future use.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cửa hàng; lưu trữ.
  • Example: We bought food at the store.
  • Example Translation: Chúng tôi mua thực phẩm ở cửa hàng.

2551. storm

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /stɔːrm/
  • English Meaning: Very bad weather with strong wind and rain.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bão.
  • Example: A storm is approaching the coast.
  • Example Translation: Một cơn bão đang tiến đến bờ biển.

2552. story

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈstɔːri/
  • English Meaning: A description of events, real or imagined.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Câu chuyện.
  • Example: My grandfather told us a story.
  • Example Translation: Ông tôi kể cho chúng tôi một câu chuyện.

2553. stove

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /stoʊv/
  • English Meaning: A device used for cooking food.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bếp.
  • Example: The soup is cooking on the stove.
  • Example Translation: Món súp đang được nấu trên bếp.

2554. straight

  • Type: Adjective, Adverb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /streɪt/
  • English Meaning: Not curved; directly.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thẳng.
  • Example: Walk straight ahead.
  • Example Translation: Hãy đi thẳng về phía trước.

2555. strange

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /streɪndʒ/
  • English Meaning: Unusual or surprising.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Kỳ lạ.
  • Example: I heard a strange noise.
  • Example Translation: Tôi nghe thấy một âm thanh kỳ lạ.

2556. stranger

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈstreɪndʒər/
  • English Meaning: A person you do not know.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Người lạ.
  • Example: Never share personal information with a stranger.
  • Example Translation: Đừng bao giờ chia sẻ thông tin cá nhân với người lạ.

2557. strategy

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈstrætədʒi/
  • English Meaning: A plan designed to achieve a goal.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chiến lược.
  • Example: We need a better marketing strategy.
  • Example Translation: Chúng tôi cần một chiến lược tiếp thị tốt hơn.

2558. stream

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /striːm/
  • English Meaning: A small flowing river.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Dòng suối.
  • Example: A clear stream runs through the forest.
  • Example Translation: Một dòng suối trong chảy qua khu rừng.

2559. street

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /striːt/
  • English Meaning: A public road in a town or city.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đường phố.
  • Example: Children were playing in the street.
  • Example Translation: Trẻ em đang chơi trên đường phố.

2560. strength

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /streŋθ/
  • English Meaning: The quality of being strong.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sức mạnh.
  • Example: Physical strength is important in this job.
  • Example Translation: Sức mạnh thể chất rất quan trọng trong công việc này.

2561. stress

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /stres/
  • English Meaning: Pressure or worry caused by difficulties; to emphasize.

questions.answerHtml:
Words 2601 to 2700 from the Oxford 3000 list - the 3000 most important words to learn in English from A1 to B2 level.

---

2601. supply

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /səˈplaɪ/
  • English Meaning: An amount of something available for use; to provide something needed.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Nguồn cung; cung cấp.
  • Example: The company supplies food to local stores.
  • Example Translation: Công ty cung cấp thực phẩm cho các cửa hàng địa phương.

2602. support

  • Type: Verb, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /səˈpɔːrt/
  • English Meaning: To help or encourage someone; help or encouragement.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Hỗ trợ; sự hỗ trợ.
  • Example: My family supports my decision.
  • Example Translation: Gia đình tôi ủng hộ quyết định của tôi.

2603. supporter

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /səˈpɔːrtər/
  • English Meaning: A person who supports a person, team, or idea.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Người ủng hộ.
  • Example: He is a supporter of the local football team.
  • Example Translation: Anh ấy là người hâm mộ đội bóng địa phương.

2604. suppose

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /səˈpoʊz/
  • English Meaning: To think that something is likely to be true.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Cho rằng; giả sử.
  • Example: I suppose you're right.
  • Example Translation: Tôi cho rằng bạn đúng.

2605. sure

  • Type: Adjective, Adverb
  • CEFR Level: A1, A2
  • IPA (US): /ʃʊr/
  • English Meaning: Certain or confident about something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chắc chắn.
  • Example: I'm sure she will come.
  • Example Translation: Tôi chắc chắn cô ấy sẽ đến.

2606. surely

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈʃʊrli/
  • English Meaning: Certainly; without doubt.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Chắc chắn.
  • Example: Surely there is a better solution.
  • Example Translation: Chắc chắn có một giải pháp tốt hơn.

2607. surface

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɜːrfɪs/
  • English Meaning: The outside or top layer of something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Bề mặt.
  • Example: The surface of the water was calm.
  • Example Translation: Bề mặt nước rất yên tĩnh.

2608. surgery

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈsɜːrdʒəri/
  • English Meaning: Medical treatment involving an operation.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Phẫu thuật.
  • Example: She had surgery on her knee.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy đã phẫu thuật đầu gối.

2609. surprise

  • Type: Noun, Verb
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /sərˈpraɪz/
  • English Meaning: An unexpected event; to cause someone to feel surprised.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sự ngạc nhiên; làm ngạc nhiên.
  • Example: The news surprised everyone.
  • Example Translation: Tin tức làm mọi người ngạc nhiên.

2610. surprised

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /sərˈpraɪzd/
  • English Meaning: Feeling unexpected wonder or shock.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ngạc nhiên.
  • Example: I was surprised by the result.
  • Example Translation: Tôi đã ngạc nhiên về kết quả đó.

2611. surprising

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /sərˈpraɪzɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: Causing surprise.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đáng ngạc nhiên.
  • Example: The result was surprising.

  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈθiːəri/
  • English Meaning: A set of ideas intended to explain something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Lý thuyết.
  • Example: Scientists developed a new theory.
  • Example Translation: Các nhà khoa học đã phát triển một lý thuyết mới.

2681. therapy

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈθerəpi/
  • English Meaning: Treatment intended to help with illness or problems.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Liệu pháp điều trị.
  • Example: She is receiving physical therapy.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy đang được điều trị bằng vật lý trị liệu.

2682. there

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ðer/
  • English Meaning: In or at that place.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ở đó.
  • Example: Put the books over there.
  • Example Translation: Hãy đặt những cuốn sách ở đó.

2683. therefore

  • Type: Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ˈðerfɔːr/
  • English Meaning: For that reason.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Vì vậy.
  • Example: It was raining; therefore, we stayed inside.
  • Example Translation: Trời mưa, vì vậy chúng tôi ở trong nhà.

2684. they

  • Type: Pronoun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ðeɪ/
  • English Meaning: Used to refer to people or things already mentioned.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Họ.
  • Example: They are my best friends.
  • Example Translation: Họ là những người bạn thân nhất của tôi.

2685. thick

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /θɪk/
  • English Meaning: Having a large distance between two sides.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Dày.
  • Example: The book is very thick.
  • Example Translation: Cuốn sách rất dày.

2686. thief

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /θiːf/
  • English Meaning: A person who steals something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Kẻ trộm.
  • Example: The thief was caught by the police.
  • Example Translation: Kẻ trộm đã bị cảnh sát bắt.

2687. thin

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /θɪn/
  • English Meaning: Having little distance between opposite sides.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mỏng; gầy.
  • Example: She wore a thin jacket.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy mặc một chiếc áo khoác mỏng.

2688. thing

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /θɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: An object, action, idea, or event.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đồ vật; sự việc.
  • Example: That is the best thing to do.
  • Example Translation: Đó là điều tốt nhất nên làm.

2689. think

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /θɪŋk/
  • English Meaning: To use your mind to consider something.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Suy nghĩ.
  • Example: I think this is a good idea.
  • Example Translation: Tôi nghĩ đây là một ý tưởng hay.

2690. thinking

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /ˈθɪŋkɪŋ/
  • English Meaning: The process of using your mind.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Sự suy nghĩ; tư duy.
  • Example: Creative thinking is an important skill.
  • Example Translation: Tư duy sáng tạo là một kỹ năng quan trọng.

2691. third

  • Type: Number, Noun
  • CEFR Level: A1, A2
  • IPA (US): /θɜːrd/
  • English Meaning: Coming after the second.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Thứ ba.
  • Example: She finished in third place.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy về đích ở vị trí thứ ba.

2692. thirsty

  • Type: Adjective
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈθɜːrsti/
  • English Meaning: Needing a drink.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Khát nước.
  • Example: I'm thirsty after the run.
  • Example Translation: Tôi khát nước sau khi chạy bộ.

2693. thirteen

  • Type: Number
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˌθɜːrˈtiːn/
  • English Meaning: The number 13.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mười ba.
  • Example: There are thirteen students in the class.
  • Example Translation: Có mười ba học sinh trong lớp.

2694. thirty

  • Type: Number
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈθɜːrti/
  • English Meaning: The number 30.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ba mươi.
  • Example: She will turn thirty next year.
  • Example Translation: Cô ấy sẽ tròn ba mươi tuổi vào năm tới.

2695. this

  • Type: Determiner, Pronoun, Adverb
  • CEFR Level: A1, B1
  • IPA (US): /ðɪs/
  • English Meaning: Used to refer to someone or something near in place or time.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đây; này.
  • Example: This book is interesting.
  • Example Translation: Cuốn sách này rất thú vị.

2696. though

  • Type: Conjunction, Adverb
  • CEFR Level: B1
  • IPA (US): /ðoʊ/
  • English Meaning: Despite the fact that.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mặc dù.
  • Example: Though it was raining, we went out.
  • Example Translation: Mặc dù trời mưa, chúng tôi vẫn ra ngoài.

2697. thought

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: A2
  • IPA (US): /θɔːt/
  • English Meaning: An idea or opinion produced by thinking.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Ý nghĩ; suy nghĩ.
  • Example: That's an interesting thought.
  • Example Translation: Đó là một ý nghĩ thú vị.

2698. thousand

  • Type: Number
  • CEFR Level: A1
  • IPA (US): /ˈθaʊzənd/
  • English Meaning: The number 1,000.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Một nghìn.
  • Example: More than a thousand people attended.
  • Example Translation: Hơn một nghìn người đã tham dự.

2699. threat

  • Type: Noun
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /θret/
  • English Meaning: Something likely to cause harm or danger.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Mối đe dọa.
  • Example: Climate change is a serious threat.
  • Example Translation: Biến đổi khí hậu là một mối đe dọa nghiêm trọng.

2700. threaten

  • Type: Verb
  • CEFR Level: B2
  • IPA (US): /ˈθretn/
  • English Meaning: To express an intention to cause harm.
  • Vietnamese Meaning: Đe dọa.
  • Example: The storm threatened the coastal towns.
  • Example Translation: Cơn bão đe dọa các thị trấn ven biển.

questions.question: Oxford 3000 Most Common American English Words (2701-2800)?
questions.searchLine: [skill • languages • english • american • oxford • 3000 • common • word • language • words-2701-2800 • words • 2701 • 2800] Oxford 3000 Most Common American English Words (2701-2800)?
questions.answerText: Words 2701 to 2800 from the Oxford 3000 list - the 3000 most important words to learn in English from A1 to B2 level. --- 2701. three - Type: Number - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /θriː/ - English Meaning: The number 3. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ba. - Example: I have three brothers. - Example Translation: Tôi có ba anh em trai. 2702. throat - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /θroʊt/ - English Meaning: The passage inside the neck through which food and air pass. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cổ họng. - Example: My throat hurts when I swallow. - Example Translation: Cổ họng tôi đau khi nuốt. 2703. through - Type: Preposition, Adverb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /θruː/ - English Meaning: From one side or end to the other. - Vietnamese Meaning: Xuyên qua; qua. - Example: We walked through the park. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi đi bộ qua công viên. 2704. throughout - Type: Preposition, Adverb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /θruːˈaʊt/ - English Meaning: In every part of something; during the whole period. - Vietnamese Meaning: Khắp; suốt. - Example: It rained throughout the day. - Example Translation: Trời mưa suốt cả ngày. 2705. throw - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /θroʊ/ - English Meaning: To send something through the air using your hand. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ném. - Example: He threw the ball to his friend. - Example Translation: Anh ấy ném quả bóng cho bạn mình. 2706. Thursday - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈθɜːrzdeɪ/ - English Meaning: The day after Wednesday. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thứ Năm. - Example: We have a meeting on Thursday. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi có cuộc họp vào thứ Năm. 2707. thus - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ðʌs/ - English Meaning: As a result; therefore. - Vietnamese Meaning: Do đó; vì vậy. - Example: The roads were icy, thus causing delays. - Example Translation: Đường đóng băng, do đó gây ra sự chậm trễ. 2708. ticket - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈtɪkɪt/ - English Meaning: A piece of paper or electronic record giving permission to enter a place or travel. - Vietnamese Meaning: Vé. - Example: I bought a train ticket online. - Example Translation: Tôi đã mua vé tàu trực tuyến. 2709. tie - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /taɪ/ - English Meaning: To fasten with a knot; a piece of clothing worn around the neck. - Vietnamese Meaning: Buộc; cà vạt. - Example: He tied his shoes before leaving. - Example Translation: Anh ấy buộc dây giày trước khi đi. 2710. tight - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /taɪt/ - English Meaning: Firmly fixed; not loose. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chật; chặt. - Example: These shoes are too tight. - Example Translation: Đôi giày này quá chật. 2711. till - Type: Conjunction, Preposition - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /tɪl/ - English Meaning: Up to the time when. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cho đến khi. - Example: Wait here till I come back. - Example Translation: Hãy đợi ở đây cho đến khi tôi quay lại. 2712. time - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A1, B2 - IPA (US): /taɪm/ - English Meaning: The measure of passing events; to measure duration. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thời gian. - Example: Time passes quickly. - Example Translation: Thời gian trôi qua nhanh chóng. 2713. tiny - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈtaɪni/ - English Meaning: Very small. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tí hon; rất nhỏ. - Example: They live in a tiny apartment. - Example Translation: Họ sống trong một căn hộ rất nhỏ. 2714. tip - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2, B1 - IPA (US): /tɪp/ - English Meaning: A useful piece of advice; to give a tip or tilt something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mẹo; tiền boa. - Example: She gave me a useful cooking tip. - Example Translation: Cô ấy cho tôi một mẹo nấu ăn hữu ích. 2715. tire - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /taɪər/ - English Meaning: The rubber covering of a wheel; to make someone tired. - Vietnamese Meaning: Lốp xe; làm mệt. - Example: The car has a flat tire. - Example Translation: Chiếc xe bị xẹp lốp. 2716. tired - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈtaɪərd/ - English Meaning: Needing rest or sleep. - Vietnamese Meaning: Mệt mỏi. - Example: I'm tired after work. - Example Translation: Tôi mệt sau giờ làm việc. 2717. title - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A1, B2 - IPA (US): /ˈtaɪtl/ - English Meaning: The name of a book, film, or document. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tiêu đề; danh hiệu. - Example: What is the title of this book? - Example Translation: Tiêu đề của cuốn sách này là gì? 2718. to - Type: Preposition, Infinitive Marker - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /tuː/, /tə/ - English Meaning: Used to show direction or as part of the infinitive form of a verb. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đến; để. - Example: I want to learn English. - Example Translation: Tôi muốn học tiếng Anh. 2719. today - Type: Adverb, Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /təˈdeɪ/ - English Meaning: On this day. - Vietnamese Meaning: Hôm nay. - Example: Today is a beautiful day. - Example Translation: Hôm nay là một ngày đẹp. 2720. toe - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /toʊ/ - English Meaning: One of the five separate parts at the end of a foot. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ngón chân. - Example: I hurt my toe while walking. - Example Translation: Tôi bị đau ngón chân khi đi bộ. 2721. together - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /təˈɡeðər/ - English Meaning: With each other; in one place or group. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cùng nhau. - Example: We worked together on the project. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi cùng nhau làm dự án. 2722. toilet - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈtɔɪlət/ - English Meaning: A room or fixture used for human waste. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nhà vệ sinh; bồn cầu. - Example: Where is the nearest toilet? - Example Translation: Nhà vệ sinh gần nhất ở đâu? 2723. tomato - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /təˈmeɪtoʊ/ - English Meaning: A soft red fruit often used as a vegetable in cooking. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cà chua. - Example: I added tomatoes to the salad. - Example Translation: Tôi đã thêm cà chua vào món sa lát. 2724. tomorrow - Type: Adverb, Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /təˈmɑːroʊ/ - English Meaning: The day after today. - Vietnamese Meaning: Ngày mai. - Example: I'll see you tomorrow. - Example Translation: Tôi sẽ gặp bạn vào ngày mai. 2725. ton - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /tʌn/ - English Meaning: A unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms (metric ton). - Vietnamese Meaning: Tấn. - Example: The truck carried a ton of sand. - Example Translation: Chiếc xe tải chở một tấn cát. 2726. tone - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /toʊn/ - English Meaning: The quality of a sound or the way someone speaks. - Vietnamese Meaning: Giọng điệu; âm sắc. - Example: Her tone sounded serious. - Example Translation: Giọng điệu của cô ấy nghe rất nghiêm túc. 2727. tongue - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /tʌŋ/ - English Meaning: The soft part inside the mouth used for tasting and speaking. - Vietnamese Meaning: Lưỡi. - Example: The soup burned my tongue. - Example Translation: Món súp làm bỏng lưỡi tôi. 2728. tonight - Type: Adverb, Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /təˈnaɪt/ - English Meaning: On the evening or night of today. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tối nay. - Example: We are going out tonight. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi sẽ ra ngoài tối nay. 2729. too - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /tuː/ - English Meaning: Also; more than enough. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cũng; quá. - Example: I want to come too. - Example Translation: Tôi cũng muốn đến. 2730. tool - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /tuːl/ - English Meaning: An object used for doing a particular job. - Vietnamese Meaning: Công cụ; dụng cụ. - Example: A hammer is a useful tool. - Example Translation: Búa là một công cụ hữu ích. 2731. tooth - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /tuːθ/ - English Meaning: One of the hard white structures in the mouth. - Vietnamese Meaning: Răng. - Example: I brush my teeth twice a day. - Example Translation: Tôi đánh răng hai lần một ngày. 2732. top - Type: Noun, Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /tɑːp/ - English Meaning: The highest part or position. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đỉnh; trên cùng. - Example: She stood on top of the hill. - Example Translation: Cô ấy đứng trên đỉnh đồi. 2733. topic - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈtɑːpɪk/ - English Meaning: A subject that people discuss or write about. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chủ đề. - Example: Climate change is an important topic. - Example Translation: Biến đổi khí hậu là một chủ đề quan trọng. 2734. total - Type: Adjective, Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈtoʊtl/ - English Meaning: Whole; the complete amount. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tổng; toàn bộ. - Example: The total cost was $50. - Example Translation: Tổng chi phí là 50 đô la. 2735. totally - Type: Adverb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈtoʊtəli/ - English Meaning: Completely. - Vietnamese Meaning: Hoàn toàn. - Example: I totally agree with you. - Example Translation: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý với bạn. 2736. touch - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: A2, B1 - IPA (US): /tʌtʃ/ - English Meaning: To put your hand on something; physical contact. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chạm; sự tiếp xúc. - Example: Don't touch the wet paint. - Example Translation: Đừng chạm vào lớp sơn còn ướt. 2737. tough - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /tʌf/ - English Meaning: Difficult, strong, or not easily damaged. - Vietnamese Meaning: Khó khăn; cứng rắn. - Example: It was a tough decision. - Example Translation: Đó là một quyết định khó khăn. 2738. tour - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2, B1 - IPA (US): /tʊr/ - English Meaning: A journey to visit places; to travel around. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chuyến du lịch; tham quan. - Example: We took a tour of the city. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi thực hiện một chuyến tham quan thành phố. 2739. tourism - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈtʊrɪzəm/ - English Meaning: The business of travel and holidays. - Vietnamese Meaning: Du lịch. - Example: Tourism is important for the local economy. - Example Translation: Du lịch rất quan trọng đối với nền kinh tế địa phương. 2740. tourist - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈtʊrɪst/ - English Meaning: A person traveling for pleasure. - Vietnamese Meaning: Khách du lịch. - Example: Many tourists visit the city every year. - Example Translation: Nhiều khách du lịch đến thăm thành phố mỗi năm. 2741. toward - Type: Preposition - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /təˈwɔːrd/ - English Meaning: In the direction of; with regard to. - Vietnamese Meaning: Hướng về; đối với. - Example: She walked toward the door. - Example Translation: Cô ấy bước về phía cánh cửa. 2742. towel - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈtaʊəl/ - English Meaning: A piece of cloth used for drying yourself or things. - Vietnamese Meaning: Khăn tắm; khăn lau. - Example: Dry your hands with a clean towel. - Example Translation: Hãy lau tay bằng một chiếc khăn sạch. 2743. tower - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈtaʊər/ - English Meaning: A tall building or structure. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tháp. - Example: We climbed the tower to see the city. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi leo lên tháp để ngắm thành phố. 2744. town - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /taʊn/ - English Meaning: A place where people live that is larger than a village but smaller than a city. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thị trấn. - Example: They moved to a small town. - Example Translation: Họ chuyển đến một thị trấn nhỏ. 2745. toy - Type: Noun, Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /tɔɪ/ - English Meaning: An object for children to play with. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đồ chơi. - Example: The child received a new toy. - Example Translation: Đứa trẻ nhận được một món đồ chơi mới. 2746. track - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2, B2 - IPA (US): /træk/ - English Meaning: A path, route, or recorded piece of music; to follow the progress of something. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đường mòn; theo dõi. - Example: The app helps you track your spending. - Example Translation: Ứng dụng giúp bạn theo dõi chi tiêu. 2747. trade - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /treɪd/ - English Meaning: The activity of buying and selling goods; to exchange goods. - Vietnamese Meaning: Thương mại; buôn bán. - Example: International trade is important for many countries. - Example Translation: Thương mại quốc tế rất quan trọng đối với nhiều quốc gia. 2748. tradition - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /trəˈdɪʃən/ - English Meaning: A belief, custom, or way of doing something passed down over time. - Vietnamese Meaning: Truyền thống. - Example: It is a family tradition to gather on New Year's Day. - Example Translation: Đó là truyền thống gia đình tụ họp vào ngày đầu năm. 2749. traditional - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /trəˈdɪʃənl/ - English Meaning: Following long-established customs or beliefs. - Vietnamese Meaning: Truyền thống. - Example: They wore traditional clothing. - Example Translation: Họ mặc trang phục truyền thống. 2750. traffic - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈtræfɪk/ - English Meaning: Vehicles moving along roads. - Vietnamese Meaning: Giao thông. - Example: Traffic was heavy this morning. - Example Translation: Giao thông sáng nay rất đông. 2751. train - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A1, A2 - IPA (US): /treɪn/ - English Meaning: A railway vehicle; to teach skills through practice. - Vietnamese Meaning: Tàu hỏa; huấn luyện. - Example: I take the train to work. - Example Translation: Tôi đi làm bằng tàu hỏa. 2752. trainer - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈtreɪnər/ - English Meaning: A person who trains people or animals. - Vietnamese Meaning: Huấn luyện viên. - Example: The trainer helped us improve our skills. - Example Translation: Huấn luyện viên giúp chúng tôi cải thiện kỹ năng. 2753. training - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈtreɪnɪŋ/ - English Meaning: The process of learning skills for a job, sport, or activity. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đào tạo; huấn luyện. - Example: The company provides employee training. - Example Translation: Công ty cung cấp chương trình đào tạo nhân viên. 2754. transfer - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /trænsˈfɜːr/ - English Meaning: To move from one place to another. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chuyển giao; chuyển khoản. - Example: She transferred to another university. - Example Translation: Cô ấy chuyển sang một trường đại học khác. 2755. transform - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /trænsˈfɔːrm/ - English Meaning: To change completely in appearance or character. - Vietnamese Meaning: Biến đổi. - Example: Technology has transformed communication. - Example Translation: Công nghệ đã biến đổi cách giao tiếp. 2756. transition - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /trænˈzɪʃn/ - English Meaning: The process of changing from one state or condition to another. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự chuyển đổi. - Example: The transition to digital systems took several years. - Example Translation: Quá trình chuyển đổi sang hệ thống số mất vài năm. 2757. translate - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /trænsˈleɪt/ - English Meaning: To change words into another language. - Vietnamese Meaning: Dịch. - Example: Can you translate this sentence into Vietnamese? - Example Translation: Bạn có thể dịch câu này sang tiếng Việt không? 2758. translation - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /trænsˈleɪʃn/ - English Meaning: The process or result of changing text into another language. - Vietnamese Meaning: Bản dịch; sự dịch thuật. - Example: The translation was very accurate. - Example Translation: Bản dịch rất chính xác. 2759. transport - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /trænˈspɔːrt/ - English Meaning: To carry people or goods from one place to another. - Vietnamese Meaning: Vận chuyển; phương tiện giao thông. - Example: Trucks transport goods across the country. - Example Translation: Xe tải vận chuyển hàng hóa khắp cả nước. 2760. transportation - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˌtrænspərˈteɪʃn/ - English Meaning: The system of moving people or goods from place to place. - Vietnamese Meaning: Vận tải; giao thông vận chuyển. - Example: Public transportation is convenient in big cities. - Example Translation: Giao thông công cộng rất thuận tiện ở các thành phố lớn. 2761. trash - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /træʃ/ - English Meaning: Things that are no longer wanted and are thrown away. - Vietnamese Meaning: Rác. - Example: Please throw the trash in the bin. - Example Translation: Hãy bỏ rác vào thùng. 2762. travel - Type: Verb, Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /ˈtrævl/ - English Meaning: To go from one place to another; the activity of traveling. - Vietnamese Meaning: Du lịch; đi lại. - Example: I love to travel around the world. - Example Translation: Tôi thích du lịch vòng quanh thế giới. 2763. traveler - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A2 - IPA (US): /ˈtrævələr/ - English Meaning: A person who is traveling. - Vietnamese Meaning: Du khách; người lữ hành. - Example: The traveler took many photos. - Example Translation: Người du khách đã chụp rất nhiều ảnh. 2764. treat - Type: Verb - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /triːt/ - English Meaning: To behave toward someone in a particular way; to provide medical care. - Vietnamese Meaning: Đối xử; điều trị. - Example: Doctors treated the injured man. - Example Translation: Các bác sĩ đã điều trị cho người đàn ông bị thương. 2765. treatment - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /ˈtriːtmənt/ - English Meaning: Medical care given to a patient. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự điều trị; phương pháp điều trị. - Example: The treatment was successful. - Example Translation: Việc điều trị đã thành công. 2766. tree - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: A1 - IPA (US): /triː/ - English Meaning: A tall plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves. - Vietnamese Meaning: Cây. - Example: We sat under a large tree. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi ngồi dưới một cái cây lớn. 2767. trend - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B1 - IPA (US): /trend/ - English Meaning: A general direction in which something is developing. - Vietnamese Meaning: Xu hướng. - Example: Online shopping is a growing trend. - Example Translation: Mua sắm trực tuyến là một xu hướng đang phát triển. 2768. trial - Type: Noun - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˈtraɪəl/ - English Meaning: A formal examination of evidence in court; trò lừa. - Example: He taught me a simple magic trick. - Example Translation: Anh ấy dạy tôi một trò ảo thuật đơn giản. 2770. trip - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A1, B2 - IPA (US): /trɪp/ - English Meaning: A journey to a place and back again. - Vietnamese Meaning: Chuyến đi. - Example: We took a trip to the mountains. - Example Translation: Chúng tôi đã có một chuyến đi lên núi. 2771. tropical - Type: Adjective - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /ˈtrɑːpɪkl/ - English Meaning: Related to hot regions near the equator. - Vietnamese Meaning: Nhiệt đới. - Example: Vietnam has many tropical fruits. - Example Translation: Việt Nam có nhiều loại trái cây nhiệt đới. 2772. trouble - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: A2, B2 - IPA (US): /ˈtrʌbl/ - English Meaning: Problems or difficulties; thật sự. - Example: I am truly grateful for your help. - Example Translation: Tôi thực sự biết ơn sự giúp đỡ của bạn. 2776. trust - Type: Noun, Verb - CEFR Level: B2 - IPA (US): /trʌst/ - English Meaning: Belief that someone is honest and reliable. - Vietnamese Meaning: Sự tin tưởng;
